"""Helper utilities."""
import re

def slugify(title):
    """Convert a title to a slug using underscores."""
    # Lowercase and replace non-alphanumeric sequences with a single underscore
    slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '_', title.lower())
    # Strip leading and trailing underscores
    return slug.strip('_')
